issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify that Animal.messageOnFeed() returns a String (e.g., UML: messageOnFeed():String and textual instructions expecting string messages like "Arf Arf!", "Oink!", "Maah!"). However, the solution implementation declares Animal.messageOnFeed() to return a FeedResponse object (and concrete animals return FeedResponse instances), introducing a different return type and an extra class not mentioned in the specification or provided template. This mismatch will confuse students: they will implement messageOnFeed() to return String as instructed, while the solution uses FeedResponse, and tests or reference solutions may diverge. It also introduces an unannounced type (FeedResponse) and forces either the solution to diverge from the spec or the students to deviate from the problem requirements.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of messageOnFeed() consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the solution to match the problem statement by changing Animal.messageOnFeed() and all overrides to return String (removing or not using FeedResponse), or (B) update the problem statement, UML, and template to specify that messageOnFeed() returns a FeedResponse (document the FeedResponse class and its purpose) and add FeedResponse to the template so students are aware of and can use it. Choose one approach and apply it uniformly to avoid confusion.

issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify Animal.messageOnFeed() should return a String, but the solution changes the method to return a FeedResponse object (and adds a new FeedResponse class). This is an inconsistent representation of the same conceptual feed-message entity across artifacts and will confuse students who are instructed to implement messageOnFeed():String but see/receive a FeedResponse-based implementation in the solution. Students may implement the method to return String (per the spec) and then be unable to map that to the solution's FeedResponse usage, or vice versa.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across all artifacts. Either (A) update the solution to have Animal.messageOnFeed() return String (and modify Seal, Pig, Goat to return the specified String messages; remove or repurpose FeedResponse), or (B) update the problem statement and template to document and require a FeedResponse return type for messageOnFeed() (including describing the FeedResponse class). Prefer option (A) to match the original exercise specification which explicitly requires messageOnFeed():String.
